Callers treating 0 as success continue: oscore.is_protected==true skips admin check, oscore.payload==NULL hits return COAP_RESPONSE_CODE_BAD_REQUEST, and the Zephyr framework auto-ACKs positive returns for CON (coap_server.c:274 in 4.1, :235 in 3.7) -\u003e two ACKs, one MID: client sees 4.01 then 4.00 (RFC 7252 mismatch), wasted LoRa airtime. Triggered by any OSCORE request with no established ctx (normal after node reboot). Affects deaddrop_post + confessions_post (coap_dtn.c:108-112, 227-231); same latent pattern in config_put/msg_inbox_post (coap_server.c). new_value: Verified fixed at HEAD. Helper ctx-miss (oscore/coap_oscore.c:62-65) returns COAP_RESPONSE_CODE_UNAUTHORIZED without sending, mirroring the unprotect-fail path; audited ALL 12 unprotect callers (coap_config x2, coap_handoff, coap_slot_coord, coap_msg x6, coap_dtn x2): every one does 'if (ret != 0) return ret' so the framework emits exactly one ACK (zephyr 4.1 coap_server.c:274 sends only for ret>0 && CON). The sole direct sender, coap_keys.c inline OSCORE path, calls send_unauthorized and returns 0 -> no framework double-ACK. 4.01-then-4.00 same-MID double response cannot occur.
